body:
PR #2796 (TASK-1981 F6/F7) round-2 fixes pushed at 5a69cbfe09.

1. [blocking, detached HEAD] Added git_ops::attached_branch (symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD). It fails closed on a detached HEAD and accepts an unborn-but-attached branch. capture_dev_release_store and commit_initial_store now resolve the branch first, inside the lock and before any stage or commit, so nothing is written on refusal. Defense in depth: push_exact_outcome now refuses a branch named `HEAD` before any remote I/O.
   New shared test task_1981_detached_store_refuses_capture_and_publication runs in both the init and release modules. It detaches the store and asserts that the capture errors, HEAD is unchanged, publish_snapshot(..,"HEAD",..) is refused, and the remote has no refs/heads/* at all.
   Note: the store write lock's own safety check already refuses a detached *store tree*, so on a real store the capture was already blocked. The new guards close the remaining paths: a non-store-tree repo, and any other caller passing "HEAD".
2. [title] Retitled to the completing form: "[AI:codex] fix(store): capture init and release publication snapshots (TASK-1981)".

Gates: make check-ci-fast passed (33 gates). make test-touched passed (193 + 147). CI is running.
subject: READY: #2796 at 5a69cbfe09 (detached-HEAD refusal + retitle)
